introHtml: Bel lanyards combine reliable construction with comfortable wear, making them a solid choice for corporate events, trade shows, and daily ID badge use. With options like the 1" Knit-In Lanyard for heavy badges or the 3/4" Woven Lanyard for a soft feel, you can match your branding needs. These lanyards hold up well under frequent use and are easy to customize with your logo through screen printing or dye sublimation.
